Organising for sustainability and innovation – Østfold University of Applied Sciences
Organising for sustainability and innovation
A Norwegian approach towards a green and digital future: making the twin green & digital transition happen
Are you interested in a Norwegian perspective on organising for innovation, creativity, and leadership? In developing your entrepreneurial mindset? Making change happen in organisations in private and public sector, and in the society at large? Developing projects and circular business models in close partnership with industry and public sector? Achieving new understandings in the role of digitalisation and circular economy?
This programme will give you tools to make change happen.
The bachelor study Innovation and Project Management at Østfold University College in Norway, is launching a new programme for international students:

All courses are taught at our campus in Fredrikstad.
The programme offers you an opportunity for project-based learning with external companies, framed in the context of the Norwegian model, i. e. the tripartite cooperation between employers, unions and government.
The programme is an international alternative integrated into the ordinary curriculum, so you will meet and work with Norwegian students and companies all the time. Students may take the courses as a full-year study, single semester or as individual courses.
